subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw add a canonical inert metadata field to group config entries, and should it apply universally or only to entries keyed by opaque identifiers?
rationale: This adds permanent public config surface, while the field name and cross-channel scope cannot be derived mechanically from existing runtime behavior.

options.title: Add scoped `label` metadata
options.body: Add optional `label` to opaque-ID-keyed group entries and preserve it through config tooling without using it for runtime matching.

options.title: Add universal metadata
options.body: Add one optional field to every channel group-entry schema for a uniform cross-channel contract, accepting broader schema and documentation work.

options.title: Keep lookup external
options.body: Decline new config surface and rely on comments or channel-resolution tooling for human-readable lookup.

recommendation.title: Add scoped `label` metadata
recommendation.body: Add optional `label` to opaque-ID-keyed group entries and preserve it through config tooling without using it for runtime matching.
